deployerhold.ponder.deployer_grip.text_1: Deployer Hold adds grip modes that latch onto Simulated handles across Sable sub-levels
deployerhold.ponder.deployer_grip.text_2: Wrench the Deployer's front face to cycle into Grip: Pull, then Grip: Hitch
deployerhold.ponder.deployer_grip.text_3: When powered, the arm extends, latches the handle, then retracts while the grip stays active
deployerhold.ponder.deployer_grip.text_4: Grip: Pull — the handle's sub-level (rider) is dragged toward the Deployer (anchor)
deployerhold.ponder.deployer_grip.text_5: Grip: Hitch — the Deployer's sub-level rides toward the handle instead
deployerhold.ponder.deployer_grip.text_6: Redstone-lock the Deployer to release the latch. Engineer's Goggles show mode and latch status
